title: Marie-Claire NDE 1094
content:
I made a suicide attempt by taking anti-depressants. In the intensive care unit, I found myself drawn to one of the room corners, being a spectator of all what was occurring. Then I entered a kind of tunnel lit by a terribly dazzling light. I hesitated a lot to go back, but someone with a very soft voice told me to do so. It was at the same time, a marvelous and terrifying experience because nobody tried to explain anything to me. After ten days being in a coma, I awoke with a chaplain sitting beside me. In fact, people expected me to die. However, this changed all my life. My vision of death (now without fear) and always - go to the main points!

However, this changed all my life. My vision of death (now without fear) and always - go to the main points!

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Suicide attempt Clinical death Suicide attempt.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was without substance, floating up to the ceiling. I was only 'alive in my mind'; I had neither arms nor legs anymore.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning There was neither time nor space any more, only feelings.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes An ethereal and luminous tunnel.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Terribly dazzling but not painful nor unpleasant.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I have the impression to have changed of dimension - to be different from the others. To look at things in perspective became much easier for me.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control As a clip which is on, very quickly, and in which some scenes are very clear and some others are fuzzy.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: No On the other hand, I became a much more intuitive person.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: No All occurred without any action from me, I was absolutely unable to change anything.
elements.What is your religion now?: Moderate non pratiquante dans les lieux consacrés
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes The fabulous, indescribable side of such an experience.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes More intuition and feelings, more sensitivity.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best side: fabulous wellbeing. The worst side: the thoughts and the look from others, powerlessness of the medical staff.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Mixed reactions. I don’t speak easily about it.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: It was too beautiful! Now, I am simply waiting for my hour, but with joy and serenity.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: The medical staff attitude should be tackled.
